name: Hermes Asymmetric Multi-Week Syndicate Heuristics Store

rule_22_nba_spread_cap_missing_alpha.name: Double-Digit NBA Spread Cap Without Primary Alpha
rule_22_nba_spread_cap_missing_alpha.description: Never lay -10.0 or higher on an NBA favorite missing its #1 franchise scorer. Cap alternate spreads on shorthanded favorites at -5.5 to -7.5.

rule_23_zero_handicap_stretching.name: Zero Handicap Stretching
rule_23_zero_handicap_stretching.description: Never stretch a handicap deeper (e.g. -5.5 to -10.5 or 0:1 to 0:2) to artificially manufacture higher odds. If odds fall below value threshold, drop match and substitute clean primary market.

rule_24_dead_rubber_rotation_filter.name: Dead-Rubber & Group-Winner Rotation Filter
rule_24_dead_rubber_rotation_filter.description: On final group-stage matchdays or end-of-season fixtures, filter out teams that have already clinched 1st place in favor of teams with active qualification/promotion stakes.

rule_25_zero_correlation_firewall.name: Strict Zero-Correlation Firewall
rule_25_zero_correlation_firewall.description: Zero fixture overlap across active slips. Every single ticket in a deployment cycle must contain 100% mutually exclusive matches.

pricing_liquidity_filter.name: Market Liquidity & Pricing Filter
pricing_liquidity_filter.description: Reject dead-money legs below 1.15 on singles or 1.12 on accumulators unless justified by overwhelming statistical dominance.

codehub_trap_filter.name: CodeHub Asymmetric Scout Trap Filter
codehub_trap_filter.description: Strip 1.02–1.07 3-way handicaps (0:3/2:0), 1st-half under traps, and bloated 40-leg lotteries. Retain only verified Tier-1 anchors.

arbitrage_hedge_protocol.name: Chronological Arbitrage & Live Hedge Lock
arbitrage_hedge_protocol.description: Trigger Principal Protection or Equalized Arbitrage Lock when potential payout reaches >= 5x cycle exposure.
